cases.reference_answer: HTTP 429 and 503 responses are retryable under the current policy.

support_spans.quote: Retryable HTTP 429 and 503 responses use exponential backoff with jitter.

cases.reference_answer: A worker crashed after the receiver stored a receipt but before acknowledgement. The retry reused a stable delivery ID, so the receiver deduplicated the sends.

support_spans.quote: A worker crashed after the receiver stored a receipt but before the worker acknowledged success.
The receiver used the stable delivery identifier as its unique receipt key, so two physical sends produced one durable business effect.

cases.reference_answer: Document the reason, actor, previous generation and incident reference before manually replaying a dead-letter job.

support_spans.quote: An operator may replay a dead-letter job only after documenting the reason, actor, previous generation, and incident reference.
